title: Character Diversity Target
statement:
You are given a string S consisting of lowercase English letters and an integer K.

In a single operation, you can choose any character in S and replace it with any other lowercase English letter.

Your goal is to make the number of distinct characters in S exactly equal to K.

Find the minimum number of operations required to achieve this. If it is impossible, output -1.
input_format:
The first line contains the string S.
The second line contains the integer K.
output_format: Print a single integer representing the minimum number of operations required, or -1 if it is impossible.
constraints: S consists only of lowercase English letters.
